dashboard.label: Admin: Ingest & Data Quality
dashboard.description: Operational health of the Wearables pipeline: per-feed freshness, cross-pipeline double-representation, unmapped activity labels + Apple metrics, and missing canonical fields. Read-only diagnostics — pairs with the "Wearables Data Quality — Monitor" scheduled search.

div.p: Everything the platform ingests lands in `widx` (index=wearables). This page watches for the things that quietly go wrong: a feed that stopped (a broken cron, an expired token), the same measurement counted twice through different pipelines, and new data shapes we haven't mapped yet (activity labels, Apple metrics). Add a row to wearable_activity_map.csv to map a new workout label; promote a useful apple:extra metric into the puller's METRIC_MAP.

panel.title: Ingest freshness — last event per feed (vendor × sourcetype, 30d)

search.query: `widx` NOT sourcetype IN (wearable_registry_backup, wearable_dq_finding) | stats count as events_30d latest(_time) as last_epoch by vendor sourcetype | eval age_h=round((now()-last_epoch)/3600,1) | eval status=case(age_h<=30,"🟢 ok", age_h<=72,"🟡 stale", true(),"🔴 critical") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_epoch,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | eval age_h=tostring(age_h), events_30d=tostring(events_30d,"commas") | table vendor sourcetype status age_h last_seen events_30d | rename age_h as "age (h)", last_seen as "last seen", events_30d as "events (30d)" | sort vendor sourcetype

panel.title: ⚠ Stale or silent feeds (> 48h since last event)

search.query: `widx` NOT sourcetype IN (wearable_registry_backup, wearable_dq_finding) | stats latest(_time) as last_epoch by vendor sourcetype | eval age_h=round((now()-last_epoch)/3600,1) | where age_h>48 | eval last_seen=strftime(last_epoch,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), age_d=tostring(round(age_h/24,1)) | table vendor sourcetype age_d last_seen | rename age_d as "age (days)", last_seen as "last seen" | sort - "age (days)"

`widx` NOT sourcetype IN (wearable_registry_backup, wearable_dq_finding) | where isnull(person_id) OR person_id="" OR isnull(vendor) OR vendor="" | eval missing=mvappend(if(isnull(person_id) OR person_id="","person_id",null()), if(isnull(vendor) OR vendor="","vendor",null())) | stats count by sourcetype missing | sort - count

panel.title: Unmapped workout activity labels (all time) — add a row to wearable_activity_map.csv

search.query: `widx` tag=wearable_workout | lookup wearable_activity_map workout_activity OUTPUT workout_activity_canon | where isnull(workout_activity_canon) | stats count as workouts values(vendor) as vendors latest(_time) as last_epoch by workout_activity | eval last_seen=strftime(last_epoch,"%Y-%m-%d"), workouts=tostring(workouts,"commas") | fields workout_activity workouts vendors last_seen | rename workout_activity as "raw label (unmapped)", last_seen as "last seen" | sort - workouts

panel.title: Unmapped Apple metrics — apple:extra (30d) — candidates for METRIC_MAP

search.query: `widx` sourcetype=apple:extra | stats sum(count) as samples dc(day) as days values(vendor) as vendors by metric | eval samples=tostring(samples,"commas") | rename metric as "apple metric (unmapped)" | sort - days

panel.title: Cross-pipeline double-representation (30d) — same person·vendor·day·domain ingested BOTH directly and via the Apple relay

search.query: `widx` (sourcetype=*sleep* OR sourcetype=*body* OR sourcetype=*bodycomp*) | eval domain=if(match(sourcetype,"sleep"),"sleep","bodycomp") | eval pipe=if(match(sourcetype,"^apple:"),"apple-relay","direct") | stats dc(pipe) as n_pipes values(pipe) as pipes values(sourcetype) as sourcetypes by person_id vendor day domain | where n_pipes>1 | eval sourcetypes=mvjoin(sourcetypes," + ") | table person_id vendor day domain sourcetypes | sort - day

panel.title: Daily ingest volume by vendor (30d) — watch for a feed dropping to zero

search.query: `widx` NOT sourcetype IN (wearable_registry_backup, wearable_dq_finding) | timechart span=1d count by vendor
